_comment: Merit badges that docs/Scouts-BSA-Requirements-2025.pdf cannot answer for,
because they were introduced, renamed, revised, or discontinued after that
book went to print. req.rb consults this list on every `show` and exits 3
with a banner when it hits one.
A badge does NOT need an entry here for req.rb to be loud about it: any name
the 2025 book does not contain already triggers the banner. This file is for
the case the book cannot detect on its own -- a badge that IS in the 2025
book but whose requirements changed afterward. Nothing local can reveal that,
so it has to be recorded by hand.
Fields, all optional except name and status:
name         the badge's current official name
effective    the year the change takes effect, e.g. "2026"
renamed_from the previous name, so the old name triggers the banner too
note         one line the Advancement Chair needs to act on
source       where the requirements actually live
Deliberately empty. Requirements change yearly and this repository's rule is
that advancement logic traces back to a document, never to recollection --
so entries go in only when someone has checked scouting.org/meritbadges.
